## The problem

What are you trying to do that pansoph does not support today?

## Proposed solution

What you would like to happen. If it touches a port or an adapter, say which one.

## Alternatives considered

Other approaches you weighed.

## Scope check

- [ ] This fits "every role is a port, every default is one adapter": it can be added as an adapter behind a port, without editing the core.
- [ ] This does not weaken the permission-correctness guarantee (a user only ever retrieves what they are allowed to see).
